diagnosis: Reward circuit (OFC/vmPFC) is on but the appeal head is average: value is felt but what is good isn't legible
Object-shape (LO) and motion (MT) areas are low: a text-first screen with no clear object silhouette
Face areas (FFA/STS) are silent: no human or gaze cue
Attention drops after the first 2 s (+0.79 → +0.63): nothing to look at after the first impression
directives: Name the value explicitly next to what the eye lands on: one benefit line + price/offer under the hero, nothing else competing.
Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
Introduce a human cue: a portrait or illustrated face whose gaze points at the CTA/product (faces win attention fastest).
Add a second discovery after the hero (a detail reveal, micro-illustration, or a strong secondary block) so interest holds past 2 s.
